dedupe_keys.name: inflow forecast evaluation real time reservoir inflow forecast evaluation for the great river hydro system

description: Cameron Bracken and colleagues at Pacific Northwest National Laboratory publish code to evaluate operational reservoir inflow forecasts. The Zenodo release is public under BSD 2-Clause NetBSD and names three Great River Hydro dams on the Connecticut River. It reads a separately archived anonymised forecast history and processed reference inflows, computes ordinary and operator-tailored skill metrics, reproduces paper figures and renders an interactive HTML dashboard. This evaluation model can test whether forecast uncertainty is useful for reservoir operation simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this evaluation workflow; the input data release is separate. Coverage is three dams and three forecast sources, two commercial products masked as A and B and one in-house series. A limitation is that provider anonymisation restricts source-specific interpretation and the code evaluates forecasts, not generating inflow predictions. The article is named in metadata, but its publication status was not independently checked. No code or data was downloaded, and metric values were not recalculated.
